mapper.sql: id, user_id, status, source, goods_amount, freight, full_reduction, coupon_deduct, points_deduct, seckill_deduct, pay_amount, coupon_id, points_used, remark, address_json, activity_id, pay_deadline, paid_at, shipped_at, completed_at, closed_at, close_reason, pay_channel, payment_no, logistics_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order_${s} (id, user_id, status, source, goods_amount, freight, full_reduction, coupon_deduct, points_deduct, seckill_deduct, pay_amount, coupon_id, points_used, remark, address_json, activity_id, pay_deadline, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{o.id}, #{o.userId}, #{o.status}, #{o.source}, #{o.goodsAmount}, #{o.freight}, #{o.fullReduction}, #{o.couponDeduct}, #{o.pointsDeduct}, #{o.seckillDeduct}, #{o.payAmount}, #{o.couponId}, #{o.pointsUsed}, #{o.remark}, #{o.addressJson}, #{o.activityId}, #{o.payDeadline}, #{o.createdAt}, #{o.createdAt})

INSERT INTO t_order_item_${s} (order_id, user_id, sku_id, spu_id, name, spec_text, art, tint, price, count) VALUES (#{i.orderId}, #{i.userId}, #{i.skuId}, #{i.spuId}, #{i.name}, #{i.specText}, #{i.art}, #{i.tint}, #{i.price}, #{i.count})
mapper.select: SELECT , '${s}' AS src FROM t_order_${s} WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, order_id, user_id, sku_id, spu_id, name, spec_text, art, tint, price, count FROM t_order_item_${s} WHERE order_id IN #{x} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order_${s} SET status = #{status}, closed_at = #{now}, close_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE t_order_${s} SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = #{paidAt}, pay_channel = #{channel}, payment_no = #{paymentNo} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE t_order_${s} SET status = 'SHIPPED', shipped_at = #{now}, logistics_json = #{logistics} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAID'
UPDATE t_order_${s} SET logistics_json = #{logistics} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SHIPPED' AND logistics_json = #{expect}
UPDATE t_order_${s} SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{now}, logistics_json = #{logistics} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SHIPPED'
UPDATE t_order_${s} SET pay_deadline = #{deadline} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

choose.otherwise: AND (CAST(o.id AS CHAR) LIKE #{q.keyword} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_order_item_${t} i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.name LIKE #{q.keyword}))

mapper.select: SELECT , '${s}' AS src FROM t_order_${s} WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND pay_deadline < #{before} ORDER BY pay_deadline LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT , '${s}' AS src FROM t_order_${s} WHERE status = 'SHIPPED' AND logistics_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY shipped_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM t_order_${s} WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') AND created_at < #{before} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order_item_archive (order_id, user_id, sku_id, spu_id, name, spec_text, art, tint, price, count, created_at, updated_at) SELECT order_id, user_id, sku_id, spu_id, name, spec_text, art, tint, price, count, created_at, updated_at FROM t_order_item_${s} WHERE order_id IN #{x} AND order_id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM t_order_item_archive WHERE order_id IN #{x}) a)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_order_${s} WHERE id IN #{x}
DELETE FROM t_order_item_${s} WHERE order_id IN #{x}
